{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA rows (before filtering)
qa_rows_before = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
num_qa_rows = len(qa_rows_before)

# Filter out QA orders
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed status
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the number of QA rows found (critical for evidence)
print(f'Number of QA rows found: {num_qa_rows}')
print(f'Number of loyal, completed orders: {len(df_loyal_completed)}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')"}
